name: claim_status_category
description: Health Care Claim Status Category Codes (STC01-1) used in 277 / 277CA.
source: X12 / Washington Publishing Company Claim Status Category Codes (public)

codes.A0: Acknowledgement/Forwarded - The claim/encounter has been forwarded to another entity.
codes.A1: Acknowledgement/Receipt - The claim/encounter has been received.
codes.A4: Acknowledgement/Not Found - The claim/encounter cannot be found.
codes.A8: Acknowledgement/Rejected for relational field in error.
codes.P1: Pending/In Process - awaiting completion of the adjudication cycle.
codes.F0: Finalized - The claim/encounter has completed the adjudication cycle.
codes.F1: Finalized/Payment - The claim/line has been paid.
codes.F2: Finalized/Denial - The claim/line has been denied.
codes.F3: Finalized/Revised - Adjudication information has been changed.
codes.F4: Finalized/Forwarded - completed and forwarded to another entity.
